# Doofinder

> > AI-powered search and discovery platform for eCommerce, offering advanced site search solutions with API integration for platforms like Prestashop, WooCommerce, and Magento.

Doofinder provides intelligent search technology that helps online stores improve product discovery, increase conversions, and enhance user experience. The site features extensive eCommerce guides, SEO strategies, marketing insights, and platform integration resources for digital commerce businesses.

## Key Topics

- Doofinder search platform
- eCommerce optimization
- Site search technology
- Prestashop integration
- WooCommerce integration
- Magento integration
- SEO for online stores
- Digital marketing strategies
- Product discovery
- Conversion optimization
- API integration
- Progressive Web Apps (PWA)
- Google Shopping
- Rich snippets
- Customer acquisition channels
